title: Discovery and business requirements
scenario: The room knows why nothing alarmed. Now it has to agree what a better night is worth, in euros, and who owns each number.
why: A fix without a measure can't be funded on Day 3. The BRD turns the problem statement into a business goal the Investment Board can judge.
objective: Write a BRD with a measurable goal, its owners, what is in and out of scope, and what must not change.

tools.name: BRD Builder
tools.for: Runs Discover, Define and Govern, and saves its session so you can resume

tools.name: rpi-research
tools.for: Only when a claim in the handoff needs checking against the code

steps: Open GitHub Copilot Chat and pick BRD Builder in the agent picker.
Answer its Discover questions from [Business impact](/#/business). Move the sliders before you agree a target, and write down who owns each one.
Before Govern, check that the BRD names what must not change.

prompts.label: Start the BRD
prompts.text: Create a BRD for zava-silent-night. Start from `.copilot-tracking/dt/zava-silent-night/problem-space-handoff.md`. The outcome is the Cost of a Silent Night on the Business impact screen. Save the BRD to `docs/project-planning/zava-silent-night-brd.md`.

ask: Which of these figures would the CFO sign?
What would make this goal look met when it isn't?
mistakes: Writing a fix as the goal, for example "add a defrost alarm"
Copying the €260,411 without asking where it comes from
step_in: When a table has written requirements before it has a goal with a number

before: Replay silent-night to 08:00 on the trainer's screen so Business impact shows the whole night

run.do: Show the euro figure. Ask the room which of these numbers they would sign.
Tables run BRD Builder. Walk the room at 15:20 and 15:40.
Each table reads its business goal aloud. Write them on the wall.
Checkpoint: executives agree the outcome, how it's measured and who owns each assumption behind it.

facilitator.good_answer: A goal with a number, a date and a measure. The reference run's BG-001: bring the Cost of a Silent Night from €260,411 to under €50,000 by month 6.
watch_for: A goal with no owner for its assumptions
A table that writes a fix as its goal. Send them back to the problem statement.
facilitator.demo: Move the shelf-value slider and watch the chain-wide figure change. That's the conversation about who owns the number.

done_when: It has at least one business goal with a number and a date
Every assumption behind the goal has an owner
It states what must not change: a scheduled defrost that ends on time raises no alarm

stuck.if: BRD Builder asks questions the table can't answer
stuck.then: Answer from Business impact and `data/business.json`, and mark the rest as assumptions

stuck.if: The table runs out of time
stuck.then: Open the reference run's BRD, agree its goal BG-001 as the table's goal and move on

handoff.note: Product definition reads the BRD's goals, rules and what must not change

loops.when: TPMs can skip the PRD when the BRD is enough
